title: Steering LLMs for Culturally Localized Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing implicit cultural defaults in responses to underspecified prompts by computing the cosine similarity between Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) feature activations of the generated text and country-specific prototype vectors (Cultural Embeddings). The paper also utilizes an LLM-as-a-judge framework to evaluate open-ended generations for cultural faithfulness and rarity.
